name: Zeno's Anthology
source:
The life of Zeno is full of interesting and lewd episodes, full of interesting and lewd women. Sometimes he plays the good guy other times the bad guy.
You can explore the stories through the branching narrative.​
translation:
芝诺的一生充满了有趣又淫荡的情节，充满了有趣又淫荡的女人。有时他扮演好人，有时扮演坏人。
你可以通过分支叙事来探索故事。​
